hooks.name: Rig test on rig save
hooks.description: When js/rig.js or a rig JSON in assets/rigs/ is saved, run scripts/test_rig.js if it exists. The script and both inputs are planned and do not exist yet, so the command is a no-op until they are added.

action.command: if [ -f scripts/test_rig.js ]; then node scripts/test_rig.js; else echo 'skip: scripts/test_rig.js does not exist yet'; fi
